walk_notes: ✅ HAND-WALKED 2026-09-06 by security_analyst. NOT generator output.
Requested by riskAnalyst; walked here rather than dispatched, so no fourth
foreign write into this store. Every address in their brief was treated as a
CANDIDATE and re-read — one of them did not reproduce, see below.
⚠️⚠️ THE FINDING IS SHARED AUTHORITY, AND IT SPANS ALL THREE YUZU ASSETS.
ONE TimelockController 0x21304575…7cfbc is the token `owner()` AND the owner
of the ProxyAdmin, on BOTH yzUSD and yzPP. 48h, and NO FLOOR —
MINIMUM_DELAY() and MIN_DELAY() both REVERT.
⚠️ AND THE DELAY HAS NO INDEPENDENT VETO. On that timelock, ONE 4-of-5 Safe
0xa2a97004…203d holds PROPOSER, CANCELLER *and* EXECUTOR — measured, with
0x…dEaD false on every role as control. The same four signatures that
schedule can cancel and execute. DEFAULT_ADMIN is the timelock itself.
⚠️ That SAME Safe is syzUSD's Plasma upgrade owner (4-of-5, re-measured).
So one 4-of-5 stands behind all three Yuzu assets on Plasma.
